bio: Choose whether to enjoy your meal in the cosy dining room with its open fireplace, in the airy conservatory or on the lovely terrace shaded by trees… This restaurant is a charming location in which to sample good regional food: the menu includes dishes such as Glückstädter Matjes (PDO preserved herring) or fillet of wild boar, cooked rare in a juniper berry jus. Tip: The lunch set menu is an excellent deal. Should you wish to stay overnight, the pretty guestrooms are very inviting and all individually decorated....
